activities.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of principles of Food and Nutrition
activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate an understanding of the dietary needs for different groups of people
activities.learning_activity: (a) Explain the concept of groups with special dietary needs (meaning, category and reasons)
suggested_methods: Brainstorming: Guide students to brainstorm on the meaning of groups with special dietary needs
Group discussion: Guide students to discuss categories of groups with special dietary needs
activities.assessment_criteria: The concept of groups with special dietary needs is well explained
suggested_resources: Charts depicting categories of groups with special dietary needs

activities.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of principles of Food and Nutrition
activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate an understanding of the dietary needs for different groups of people
activities.learning_activity: (b) Analyse the nutritional requirements for each special group (children, adolescents, elders, vegetarians, pregnant women and lactating mothers, invalids and convalescents)
suggested_methods: Scenario: Provide a scenario for students to identify nutritional needs of groups with special dietary needs then guide them to share
Field trip: Organise a field trip to health centres for students to observe nutrition education provided and write the report

activities.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of principles of Food and Nutrition
